plugins.prepareCmd: mvn -B -ntp versions:set -DnewVersion=${nextRelease.version} -DgenerateBackupPoms=false && mvn -B -ntp -DskipTests package && docker build -t $BACKEND_IMAGE:${nextRelease.version} .
plugins.publishCmd: docker push $BACKEND_IMAGE:${nextRelease.version} && if [ "${nextRelease.channel}" = "dev" ]; then docker tag $BACKEND_IMAGE:${nextRelease.version} $BACKEND_IMAGE:dev && docker push $BACKEND_IMAGE:dev; else docker tag $BACKEND_IMAGE:${nextRelease.version} $BACKEND_IMAGE:latest && docker push $BACKEND_IMAGE:latest; fi
